promotion_constraints: Frozen baseline command ID and exact HTML/CSS SHA-256 must verify before visual conditioning begins.
Implementation visual input is evidence, not new creative authority; Website Business remains upstream creative owner.
Candidate A and Candidate B remain isolated and start from the same frozen baseline; no cross-candidate code, screenshots, critique, or patch reuse.
Each initial candidate must pass deterministic source integrity before its own screenshots may be used for correction.
Each candidate gets at most one screenshot-conditioned correction pass; that correction may not self-approve and must pass source integrity again before independent downstream QA.

The correction pass may use only the frozen baseline screenshots, that candidate's own screenshots, approved source/spec, and its own critique/intent; it may not use the other candidate or prior failed candidate artifacts.
Verified facts, exact links/assets, services, business journeys, semantics, accessibility invariants and zero-external-action authority must remain unchanged.

A candidate is promotable only at calibrated implementationQuality >=92, source/browser/accessibility/visual/security PASS, materially BETTER than baseline, agencyQuality=true, and final Challenger PASS.
If neither candidate qualifies, restore and retain the frozen baseline; no manual merge or rescue outside the governed loop.
Preview deployment remains a separate approval-gated action.
